name: search_knowledge_graph
description: Universal Knowledge Graph Search Tool — Query multi-domain knowledge including technical descriptions (Thai/English), trading strategies, hardware specs, and creative content seeds via hybrid graph + vector search.

search_query.description: Natural language search query in Thai or English. Example: 'algorithmic trading strategies' or 'กลยุทธ์การเทรดอัตโนมัติ'

result.description: Formatted Markdown context block with search results

SEARCH_TOP_K.description: Number of top results to return per search

SEARCH_MAX_HOPS.description: Maximum graph traversal hops for context expansion

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins (use '*' for all)

function.name: search_knowledge_graph
function.description: Search the Universal Knowledge Graph for concepts, equations, hardware specifications, trading strategies, and creative content seeds. The graph contains multi-domain knowledge with technical descriptions (Thai and English), simple explanations for general audience, analogies comparing technical concepts to everyday things, and creative fiction seeds inspired by technical knowledge.

search_query.description: Natural language search query in Thai or English. Example: 'algorithmic trading strategies' or 'กลยุทธ์การเทรดอัตโนมัติ'
